comments.text: This video really makes you think. The biggest surprise for me was realizing that most refugees actually stay in neighboring countries, while the Gulf countries mainly offer work visas rather than long-term protection. That final line says it all: “The Gulf lets you in to work. Europe lets you ask to stay.” Such an important difference, and something I never looked at this way before. 👏
